key_idea: Assuming periodicity, one can contract different sets of edges of the tile to form two periodic limit tilings whose translation lattices would be related by an impossible geometric scaling factor.
reason: The proof introduces a stunningly original insight by embedding the discrete tile into a continuous family and studying its degenerate limits. This yields a highly conceptual, computation-free contradiction with profound explanatory power, requiring only moderate geometric bookkeeping to verify the affine map's properties.
recognized: An aperiodic monotile (the 'hat') by Smith, Myers, Kaplan, and Goodman-Strauss (2023)
